sources: https://conestoga-campground.com/ (read via a fetch tool; plain curl and the headless browser got connection resets)
https://www.campspot.com/book/conestogacampground (Campspot park 2814 record and availability API, one night from 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-27, 2 adults; 2027 dates not yet open), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 53 RV sites: Premium pull-throughs to 45 ft, Deluxe pull-throughs to 42 ft, Standard pull-through or back-in to 40 ft, Basic water/electric pull-throughs to 35 ft; also tent sites and rustic cabins.

sites.source: https://conestoga-campground.com/amenities ('53 RV Sites - Room for RVs of all sizes') + https://conestoga-campground.com/rates (Premium RV Site pull-through up to 45 ft, Deluxe 42 ft, Standard 40 ft pull-through or back-in, Basic 35 ft pull-through), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://conestoga-campground.com/rates ('Premium RV Site' and 'Deluxe RV Site': full hookups 20/30/50 amp; 'Basic RV Site': water/electric 20/30 amp) + https://conestoga-campground.com/amenities ('Up to full hook up 20/30/50A power'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hot showers and coin laundry 24 hours a day, fiber-optic WiFi, small camp store, playground, pond for wildlife viewing. Dump station $15 per use for non-guests or dry campers.

facilities.source: https://conestoga-campground.com/amenities ('Clean/Hot Showers 24 hours a day', 'Coin Operated Laundry 24 hours a day', 'High speed WiFi (Fiber Optic service)', 'Small camp store', 'Pond for wildlife viewing') + https://conestoga-campground.com/rates ('RV Dump Station - $15 per use'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: '2026 Season - May 1st - Nov 1'. Some sites may have limited water early (May) and late (October) in the season because of cold weather.

season.source: https://conestoga-campground.com/ ('2026 Season - May 1st - Nov 1', 'Due to cold weather conditions, there may be limited water available at some sites during the early (May) & late (Oct) parts of the season.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Paid in full at booking; cancellations at least 48 hours before arrival are refunded less a cancellation fee; no refund for early departures or no-shows. Check-in from 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://conestoga-campground.com/ (booking link https://www.campspot.com/book/conestogacampground; 'CHECK IN - STARTS @ 1 PM.', 'CHECK OUT - 11 am') + https://conestoga-campground.com/rates (payment and cancellation terms), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Passport America: call for a promo code. One membership discount per stay, 14 days at most, requested at booking; not on holiday weekends or during special events.

discounts.source: https://conestoga-campground.com/rates (membership discounts, 'DISCOUNTS NOT AVAILABLE DURING HOLIDAY WEEKENDS OR SPECIAL EVENTS', Passport America promo code by phone) + https://conestoga-campground.com/ ('Membership Affiliations ... Passport America'), read 2026-10-22
